entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Answering Lament

*Its outline shudders with the injury and a grieving note rises from somewhere behind the attacker.*

After an attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, one visible attacker within 3 squares that can hear it gains Frightened 2 of this creature. This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. Frightened applies only while this creature is perceptible.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Lifeless Body:** does not breathe or eat; only the listed immunities apply.

**Healing:** Spirit: magical healing works; potions cannot be swallowed.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Ash-gray ribbons hang from trees along its route.

**Purpose:** Gather witnesses for an uncompleted funeral.

**Tactics and retreat:** Sound its bell at a cluster, then drift away while they recover.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Speak the names of the unburied or carry the bell toward consecrated ground.

**Habitat:** Battlefield; marsh · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** A recovered list of the lost; a grateful community may offer 60 coins.

**Summoning:** Spirit 7 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/summons/mourning-bell.md).
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-mourning-bell


**Category:** Spirit · **Role:** Area controller · **CV:** 52

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 3/4/6

**Reference type:** mental

**Expected targets:** 2

**Utility factor:** 1.7

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.6 → 1.7: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=2.404, O=9.306. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [Answering Lament](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/answering-lament.md), [lifeless body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/lifeless-body.md), [mind hammer](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/mind-hammer.md).

# Answering Lament

*Its outline shudders with the injury and a grieving note rises from somewhere behind the attacker.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-answering-lament

**Action:** Reaction

After an attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, one visible attacker within 3 squares that can hear it gains Frightened 2 of this creature. This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. Frightened applies only while this creature is perceptible.

monsterAbilityTemplates.rulesMarkdown:
The card must list its exact condition immunities; this trait grants no additional unlisted ones. It does not breathe or need food.
